messages:
zoe.l: Hey all, I'm Zoe (new infra eng). First-week ask: I need to run a quick validation that writes a few rows to BigQuery dataset billing_validation in project zoe-sbx, and also need to deploy a small helper Lambda in the infra AWS account that reads those rows for a smoke test. Who owns the perms and what's the minimal set I should request? cc @cloud-ops
peter: welcome Zoe! :wave: For GCP give a sandbox SA limited to that dataset (roles/bigquery.dataEditor). Give your user roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on that SA so CI/GKE pods can impersonate.
cloud-ops: For the Lambda in infra account we prefer creating a cross-account assume-role with an inline policy scoped to the specific Lambda actions (lambda:CreateFunction, lambda:UpdateFunctionCode, iam:PassRole if it needs an execution role). Also scope S3 or ECR writes if you're uploading artifacts.
infra-bot: Please use the cloud-access template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?project=CLOUD Choose 'Onboarding - IAM/Permissions' and include GCP project, dataset, k8s ns/ksa (or CI OIDC info), AWS account id, Lambda name/prefix, S3/ECR location, and desired expiry.
zoe.l: any region gotchas? I'd prefer eu-west1 for BigQuery and eu-west-1 for AWS Lambda artifacts.
billing-admin: FYI org policy blocks some billing export actions in EU for certainorg folders. If you need the dataset in eu-west1 mention it explicitly; linking to a billing account to enable exports requires billing-admins to run it or a Billing Account User role.
peter: snippet for ticket if infra will pre-provision: ```bash
# create SA and allow you to impersonate
gcloud iam service-accounts create zoe-billing-sa --project=zoe-sbx --display-name="zoe billing writer"
# dataset-level grant
bq add-iam-policy-binding zoe-sbx:billing_validation --member=serviceAccount:zoe-billing-sa@zoe-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding zoe-billing-sa@zoe-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --member=user:zoe.l@redwood.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```
cloud-ops: For AWS trust, paste this in ticket for infra to create assume-role (they will tighten principal): ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:root"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
```
zoe.l: great, I'll file the ticket. Prefer a 10d expiry for validation and temporary Lambda creds. Thanks everyone! :smile:
